    // jQuery/remodal calls inside the IIFE (they may not be loaded yet).
    var unifiedRemodalInstance = null;

    // Expose as _unifiedAuthModalOpen, called from openSigninModal in main.js
    window._unifiedAuthModalOpen = function(event, redirect, source, mode) {
        if (event) event.preventDefault();
        currentRedirect = redirect || '';
        currentSource = source || '';

        // Reset state — default to Login view, unless mode='register'
        if (mode === 'register') {
            switchToRegister();
        } else {
            switchToLogin();
        }
        document.getElementById('authRegEmail').value = '';
        document.getElementById('authLoginEmail').value = '';
        document.getElementById('authLoginPassword').value = '';
        if (document.getElementById('authRegNewsletter')) {
            document.getElementById('authRegNewsletter').checked = false;
        }
        isRegistering = false;
        isLoggingIn = false;
        document.getElementById('authRegSubmit').textContent = 'Continue';
        document.getElementById('authLoginSubmit').textContent = 'Log In';

        var loginShell = document.getElementById('loginModal');
        var modalContent = document.getElementById('unifiedAuthModalContent');

        // Inject content into shell once (no innerHTML reset — preserves remodal DOM bindings)
        if (loginShell && modalContent && modalContent.parentNode !== loginShell) {
            loginShell.appendChild(modalContent);
            modalContent.style.display = 'block';
        }

        // Initialize remodal once, then reuse cached instance
        if (!unifiedRemodalInstance && loginShell) {
            unifiedRemodalInstance = $(loginShell).remodal();
        }

        if (unifiedRemodalInstance) {
            unifiedRemodalInstance.open();
        }

        // Load captcha after modal is visible
        setTimeout(function() {
            loadCaptcha();
        }, 300);
    };
})();
</script>
